01 / about

Husband. Father. Builder.

Thirteen years at American Express, the last six on the AI side. I helped build the rubrics and calibration protocols behind our annotation program, and by 2025 I owned the annotation and quality lifecycle end to end for three production models: the U.S. Chatbot, the U.K. Chatbot, and Document AI.

I believe a man should build things that matter, protect what he loves, keep learning, and use his skills to help others. That mindset drives the way I approach technology. I build AI tools, automation systems, and dashboards that bring order to chaos and help people move with more clarity and confidence.

My work is practical by design. Crypto research tools, job search agents, creator analytics, automation workflows, and technical experiments all come from the same place: solve the problem, sharpen the system, and make the next move better.

I love my wife, I love my kids, and I want the work I create to reflect discipline, service, and purpose.

I am also actively sharpening my technical foundation in Python, SQL, JavaScript, and other coding stacks. I use AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude as learning partners, debugging support, and build assistants — but the goal is always the same: understand the work, improve the system, and keep getting better.

Build what matters. Technology should make people stronger, sharper, and more capable.
